assets.name: 老公寓3号房钥匙
assets.design: An old apartment door key, a simple ROUND red-brown bakelite bow with a circular hole near the outer end, matte worn OXBLOOD RED plastic around the bow, a visibly tarnished warm BRASS shaft with three large conventional asymmetric cylinder-key teeth along its lower-left edge near the tip. A mundane familiar house key, nicked edges and modest age, readable large round red handle, no elaborate ornaments.
